projects.name: Amazon Copilot
projects.description: An AI-powered product review analysis and insight generation project.
projects.details: Amazon Copilot is designed to analyze product reviews and generate useful insights using an AI-powered workflow. The project uses a FastAPI backend and RAG-based architecture.

projects.name: Campus Sustainability Dashboard
projects.description: A data analysis and visualization project for monitoring campus sustainability metrics.
projects.details: The project analyzes campus sustainability data including water consumption, energy usage, waste generation, recycling rates and related metrics. Python-based data analysis and machine learning were used alongside Power BI for visualization.

projects.name: Flipkart GRIDLOCK
projects.description: A traffic optimization project exploring machine learning approaches for improving traffic signal management.
projects.details: Flipkart GRIDLOCK explores the use of machine learning to analyze traffic patterns and support improved traffic signal management and optimization.

projects.name: AI Portfolio
projects.description: A production-deployed AI-powered developer portfolio with a React frontend, FastAPI backend and LLM-powered AI assistant.
projects.details: The AI Portfolio is a full-stack developer portfolio featuring a React and Vite frontend, a FastAPI backend and an AI assistant powered by an LLM. The application has been deployed to production with the frontend and backend connected through a production API.
